name: 3,2,1...Gone
source:
Play as The Crooked Man's apprentice as you are interrogated by Zhen, one of the agents of the Supernatural Organisation 'Blood, Bone and Ash'.  Just take a deep breath...and count 3...2...1.

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/321gone]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演歪人的学徒，接受超自然组织“血骨灰”特工之一甄的审问。只需深吸一口气…然后数3…2…1。

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/321gone]itch.io[/url]]
